# glinet_dpi (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet DPI engine settings. Signature updates are handled by the firmware.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `expire_time` (Number) Flow expiry in seconds; zero leaves the firmware value.
- `library_auto_update` (Boolean) Update the DPI library automatically.
- `log_level` (String) DPI log level.
- `ota_auto_update` (Boolean) Update signatures over the air.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
